Approach

Seven of those twenty years were customer-facing. As Lead Solutions Architect at IBM I ran on-site requirement sessions with CIOs and technical stakeholders, designed hybrid and multi-cloud target architectures, presented and demoed them to executive and engineering audiences, and stayed with the work through implementation and handoff. At VMware I owned a cloud lab platform end to end — qualifying leads, running discovery calls, delivering live demos, guiding customers to the right subscription — while running the vSphere and NSX infrastructure the platform depended on.

The other side is production. Reliability engineering, SLOs and error budgets, observability, Infrastructure as Code, incident response, and cloud cost optimization across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. The reason both halves matter together: an architecture you have never operated is a guess, and a platform you cannot explain to the person funding it does not get funded.

Outside of delivery work I mentor engineers moving into reliability roles, and I write about what breaks and why. Native Spanish, fluent English.
